## Independence and full M1 basis

The reviewer authored none of the implementation, tests or corrections. Earlier involvement was independent Delivery/Code Review only. Current complete M1 is assessed using the full initial implementation inspection, the full-verifier/preservation correction assessment in round 2 and a fresh inspection of the exact final receipt correction and its integration proof. No engineering, activity or work edits were made by this reviewer.

The final diff includes candidate construction and tests, approval-driven preparation, the retained full verifier's prepared-candidate path, prepublication release validation and the bounded dependent adapter assertion correction. It contains no M2 publisher, M3 hosted activation or M4 source retirement. Current work/context remains M1 in progress and M2–M4 pending; approved Design/Delivery normative subjects are unchanged. The complete engineering diff is cc08bd53 through 3dcea08b and the inspected working tree matches that handoff.

Round 2's passing semantic conclusions are reused only for unchanged code and requirements. Its confidentiality concern is reassessed against new bytes, not silently carried forward. The final two changed source/test subjects match release-m1-implementation-r3; other M1 correction subjects retain the r2 basis. Historical review judgments keep their original identities and limitations.

## Reporter disposition of release-m1-f3

Resolved. recorded_command separates actual argv from durable evidence. Absolute inputs under the declared candidate directory become stable <candidate>/artifact names, and source-root inputs become repository-relative names. Undeclared absolute paths raise an explicit error. verify_prepared_release runs the original argv, then stores only that bounded representation. Artifact filenames and digests remain in the candidate binding; the change does not replace exact bytes with a lossy label or modify actual validation commands.

The focused synthetic-private-directory regression preserves the command family and exact logical tarball association while excluding the private prefix. The complete integration now inspects the real generated release-verification.json and rejects a workspace-root leak before the candidate is considered proved. Registered r3 proof reports 121 tests passing in 51.792 seconds, including the actual full verifier/archive/package/packed-install chain. This reviewer read the final log's matching pass and independently ran python scripts/test-release-transaction.py -k verification_receipt: one test passed. Additional direct serializer probes confirmed repository-relative script representation and rejection of an undeclared absolute input.

No raw private path is retained in the affected successful receipt command fields. Private local failure logs remain a separate diagnostic surface and are not copied into this successful candidate receipt. Future M2 public failure/report projection must continue applying REL-SR-17 at its own boundary; this M1 assessment does not preapprove that future code.

## Complete M1 checklist

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | Allocated immutable candidate, real full-check composition, preserved human/history content and safe receipt representation are present. |
| Test coverage | pass | Existing 121-test result exercises complete actual candidate chain, required release/security negatives, original preservation fixes and receipt privacy; reviewer focused checks corroborate the final correction. |
| Edge cases | pass within M1 | Missing/unknown version/profile/check values, invalid refs/path/symlink and artifact tampering retain direct tests; missing/failed security, secret notes, pending expectations and human/idempotency cases remain covered. |
| Error handling | pass | Required checks/facts block verified candidate production; unsupported inputs reject; timing alone remains diagnostic after valid profile authority; no publication occurs. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Candidate invokes retained release-verify.sh → validate-release.py ownership with sealed outputs. Archive facts precede bundled metadata/index, packing and outer evidence; M2/M3 remain disconnected as planned. |
| Compatibility | pass | Legacy default/finalized timing and preparation paths are retained; new mode protects human text and existing finalized observations. |
| Security/privacy | pass for M1 | Secret-bearing release content rejects; subprocess arguments are fixed; durable receipt commands are normalized with explicit rejection outside declared roots. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass within fixture scope | Current proof observes actual archives, C/proof/public/packed metadata and index, tarball contents and all three packed-init paths, with exact file bindings. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Scope remains M1 producer/check/preservation/receipt code, tests and attributed records; no real release or packaged checkout version change. |
| Validation evidence | pass for milestone | Actual full 121-test result matches current corrected subjects; focused reviewer checks pass. No hosted/publication/final-Verify claim follows. |

The adjusted adapter regression retains exact archive/schema/validation and release version/tag/repository invariants, while actual candidate source/proof/index checks own the formerly placeholder-specific fields. This remains useful protection rather than unchecked snapshot relaxation. Pending public event/smoke values remain expectations; the actual local verification receipt supplies local results only. All original required findings have explicit reporter dispositions.

## Checks and limitations

Actually performed: final/cumulative diff and clean handoff inspection; current complete scoped context; exact subject inspection and comparison; final registered r3 evidence and log inspection; one focused verification_receipt test; direct source-relative and undeclared-absolute serializer probes; targeted review/disposition recording. Scoped record-store validation and git diff --check follow the save.

The reviewer did not rerun the full 121-test suite, perform real publication, configure remote protection or claim hosted CI success. Full-suite results are attributable to the implementation record, with their fixture boundaries preserved. This approval closes only M1's assessment. M2 execution, M3 one-approval CI/full operator path, M4 six-source retirement, independent milestone assessments, fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain required. Route owns continuation and stored work state.
independence_basis: Independent nonauthor assessed complete M1 through prior full inspections and fresh final correction/proof on exact current subjects; authored no implementation or tests and changed no engineering/routing. Original reporter owns all three explicit finding dispositions.
